detail_text: Sources Sought Notice: SPRDL1-26-R-0063 Item Name: Pump Unit, Centrifugal NSN: 4320-01-691-1985 Part Number: M52109 / CAGE: 19207 Base Quantity = 30 EA Option Quantity = 30 EA End Item: Water Supply and Water Purification Equipment RESPONSE DATE: 12 March 2026 REQUIREMENTS DESCRIPTION: “Centrifugal pumps are mechanical devices used to transport fluids by converting mechanical energy from an external source (e.g., an electric motor) into kinetic energy in the fluid being pumped. They work by using a rotating impeller to create a centrifugal force that moves the fluid through the pump and into the discharge pipe.” Rotech Pumps & Systems PLEASE NOTE: • This notice is NOT an open solicitation (i.e. Invitation for Bid or Request for Proposal). • Qualification testing and evaluation IS required to become an approved source. • Source approval does NOT guarantee business. • Qualifying as an approved source ONLY provides the opportunity to compete on future solicitations.
